packageRules.description: Pinned by the workflows that use them, and bumped when the shared actions repository bumps them. A pull request here would only ever disagree with TimSchoenle/actions.

testcontainers-modules requires the same testcontainers minor it was released against. 0.15 needs 0.27, so 0.28 fails to resolve. Lift this once a testcontainers-modules release depends on testcontainers 0.28, and bump both in one pull request.

cargo-chef stays enabled, unlike in the other repositories of this estate. They track the floating latest-rust-alpine tag, which has nothing to bump; this Dockerfile pins it by digest, so leaving it disabled would freeze the build toolchain image at whatever digest was current the day it was written.
The Dagger CLI in build.yaml and the engine version in dagger.json must be the same release, so they move in one pull request.

customManagers.description: Container images the Dagger module pins. Only the `name:tag@sha256:digest` form is recognised, so an image without a digest fails review rather than going unmaintained.

Versions named by a `renovate:` comment on the line above them, in the Dagger module and in workflows. The datasources are listed so that a release-attachment pin, which carries a digest, is matched only by the manager below.
Release assets the Dagger module downloads, pinned to a tag and the asset's SHA-256. Renovate bumps the tag and recomputes the digest of the same asset in the new release.
The engine version the Dagger module declares.
